lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: # flask-6096: Fix partition on IPv6 addresses

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: PR #6096, fixes issue #6093. Four review comments and three conversation comments.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Why: present. Issue #6093 says partition breaks session_transaction and Flask.run with SERVER_NAME. PR body says fix two usages and links the issue. One story.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Size: small. Four files and about 23 added lines. Two one line fixes with tests.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Parts: one story. Groups: 1 or 2.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. Run with SERVER_NAME: `src/flask/app.py`, `tests/test_basic.py`. Urlsplit parses the name so IPv6 hosts work.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. Session transaction cookies: `src/flask/testing.py`, `tests/test_testing.py`. Hostname comes from urlsplit with localhost fallback.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: One group with all four files is best. The concern is one pattern in two places. Two groups split as above are also good.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - SERVER_NAME with an IPv6 address and port parses to the right host and int port in Flask.run, covered for [::1]:8080.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - session_transaction keeps cookies for IPv6 base URLs because the cookie domain falls back to localhost instead of an empty string.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The // prefix lets urlsplit read SERVER_NAME as a netloc. The author notes this choice in review comments.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Host fallback is localhost when hostname is None. The author follows Werkzeug behavior here.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Dev job failures are expected until the next Werkzeug release. The maintainer says so in conversation comments.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not make a group per file or per test file. Each test stays with its source.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not add lookFor for resolved review notes or CI noise. No open concern remains.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not invent motive beyond the issue and PR. One story covers both fixes.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not repeat PR text as fact. Check each claim at head.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Baseline

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - First musecode run: 2 groups in the split shape, parts 0, size small, claims 0 of 2 at the old code level wording. The review stated both fixes, so the claims moved to reader takeaway level.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Second musecode run: same shape, still 0 of 2. The review states locations and coverage but not outcomes. The misses read as thin lookFors plus a strict grader. Claims stay.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Third musecode run: same shape, claims 1 of 2. One reworded takeaway lands.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## case.json

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `why` is present. Issue and PR name one story.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `parts` 0 to 1. One story means zero or one part.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `groups` 1 to 3. Story allows 1 or 2, with slack.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `size` trivial or small. Best estimate is small.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `sourceKinds` ticket and pr. Both name the story.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `together` pairs each source with its test. This holds for one group and for two groups.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - No `apart`. No pair must stay apart in a good review.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Added the two claims from Must state.
